## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D Overwatch-style 1v1 arena game featuring two selectable heroes.

## Requirements
- Provide a playable best-of-3 duel against an AI rival.
- Include hero selection, combat abilities, health, round scoring, game HUD, and mobile controls.
- Use a visually polished neon sci-fi arena aesthetic.

## Decisions
- Implemented the game as a self-contained canvas-based experience in `index.html`.
- Added Nova and Bulwark as the two player hero choices.
- Added keyboard/mouse and touch control support.
- Used a best-of-3 match structure.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the full game menu and hero selection UI.
- Built the neon sci-fi arena, arena cover objects, lighting, and 2D/canvas 3D-style rendering.
- Implemented player movement, aiming, shooting, AI movement/shooting, health, abilities, rounds, scoring, and victory/defeat flow.
- Implemented pause, overdrive, dash, pulse, and mobile touch controls.
- Added desktop and mobile responsive layouts.
- Started a local server and validated the page with browser screenshots.
- Confirmed the browser console had no application errors after reload.

### Active
- None.

### Blocked
- None.

## Next Move
1. Run or preview `index.html` through the existing local server.
2. Continue QA by testing round completion, abilities, hero differences, and mobile interactions in-browser.
3. Add any additional visual or gameplay polish requested after testing.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: Complete implementation of the game and UI.
- `/tmp/opencode/neon-front.jpg`: Latest desktop/mobile screenshot used for visual QA.

## Important Context
- The implementation is in a single `index.html` file.
- JavaScript syntax was validated with `node --check /tmp/opencode/game.js`.
- Browser validation was performed at 1280×720 and 390×844.
- The game uses canvas 2D with manually projected 3D-style arena geometry rather than a WebGL/Three.js renderer.
